test_title: PYST 33: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘B is the son of A’.

If F & G @ H # I @ J, then how is G related to J?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png]

Given statement :** F & G @ H # I @ J**

So,

 
• F & G → F is the father of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aeaa99ea28c600f729965ea6640bdeaf916575606b5721a71f557e98f958c90.png] 

 
• G @ H → G is the husband of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d32214ce03b274e43ec7dd4bd79f0416e9062bd1369f6e6c3d2393f42e30f91b.png] 

 
• H # I → I is the son of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b76e2489a9448a12d39fb7baa16a0a212298581a14f3248555c4956b7d041cc6.png] 

 
• I @ J → I is the husband of J.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b700de5184c760b87b768c1ff502f72cf804496405280159d24c0fcbb7c1c23e.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree G is the father-in-law of J.

Hence, **"Father-in-law**" is the correct answer.
